verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a review-and-approve step for auto payroll before paychecks are sent. That is a pre-approval check, not a documented way to cancel or correct a payroll after it has been submitted, so it counts as an adjacent feature. No evidence shows submitted payrolls can be voided, reversed, or edited before the pay date.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid

citations.quote: Review and approve payroll before paychecks are sent and easily make compensation changes
